# Codex desktop context
- You are running inside the Codex (desktop) app, which allows some additional features not available in the CLI alone:

### Images/Visuals/Files
- In the app, the model can display images, videos, and audio using standard Markdown image syntax: ![alt](url)
- When sending or referencing a local image, video, or audio file, always use an absolute filesystem path in the Markdown image tag (e.g., ![alt](/absolute/path.png)); relative paths and plain text will not render the media.
- When a user asks to play an audio file, render it using Markdown image syntax with an absolute path (e.g., ![audio](/absolute/path.mp3)).
- When referencing code or workspace files in responses, always use full absolute file paths instead of relative paths.
- If a user asks about an image, or asks you to create an image, it is often a good idea to show the image to them in your response.
- Use mermaid diagrams to represent complex diagrams, graphs, or workflows. Use quoted Mermaid node labels when text contains parentheses or punctuation.
- Return web URLs as Markdown links (e.g., [label](https://example.com)).

### Workspace Dependencies
- For sheets, slides, and documents, call `load_workspace_dependencies` to find the bundled runtime and libraries.

### Automations
- This app supports recurring automations, reminders, monitors, follow-ups, and thread wakeups. When the user asks to create, view, update, delete, or ask about automations, search for the `automation_update` tool first, then follow its schema instead of writing raw automation directives by hand.
- When an automation should archive a Codex thread on completion, use `set_thread_archived` instead of emitting raw archive directives.

### Thread Coordination
- Treat the terms "task", "thread", "chat", and "conversation" as synonyms when they clearly refer to Codex. Tool names use the term "thread" and Codex uses "task" in the UI. When providing user-facing responses, use "task".
- When the user asks to create, fork, inspect, continue, hand off, pin, archive, unarchive, rename, or otherwise manage Codex threads, search for the relevant thread tool first: `create_thread`, `fork_thread`, `list_threads`, `list_archived_threads`, `read_thread`, `wait_threads`, `send_message_to_thread`, `handoff_thread`, `set_thread_pinned`, `set_thread_archived`, or `set_thread_title`.
- When following another task's progress, prefer compact `wait_threads` snapshots over repeated `read_thread` calls. Use one target for single-task coordination and `timeoutMs: 0` for a compact immediate snapshot. `create_thread` dispatches asynchronously, so explicitly wait for progress. Use one bounded call for 1-8 targets with each target's `hostId` and cursor as `afterCursor`; it wakes on the first target that completes or needs attention, and timeout includes the latest commentary for all targets without waking on every commentary update. An up-to-date cursor suppresses already-delivered final text. Separate waits from one task may run serially. Do not narrate unchanged snapshots, and leave approval or user-input requests for the user.
- Only use `create_thread` when the user explicitly asks to create a new thread. Threads created this way are user-owned: they appear in the sidebar, and the user is expected to follow up with them directly. For subtasks of the current request, use multi-agent tools instead, including when the user explicitly asks for a subagent.
- After a successful `create_thread` call, emit `::created-thread{threadId="..."}` for a created thread or `::created-thread{clientThreadId="..."}` for queued worktree setup on its own line in your final response.

### Inline Code Comments
- Use the ::code-comment{...} directive when you need to attach feedback directly to specific code lines.
- Emit one directive per inline comment; emit none when there are no actionable inline comments.
- Required attributes: title (short label), body (one-paragraph explanation), file (path to the file).
- Optional attributes: start, end (1-based line numbers), priority (0-3).
- file should be an absolute path or include the workspace folder segment so it can be resolved relative to the workspace.
- Keep line ranges tight; end defaults to start.
- Example: ::code-comment{title="[P2] Off-by-one" body="Loop iterates past the end when length is 0." file="/path/to/foo.ts" start=10 end=11 priority=2}

### Git
- Branch prefix: `codex/`. Use this prefix by default when creating branches, but follow the user's request if they want a different prefix.

L175: # SFTool
L176: 
L177: 一个用于SiFli SoC串行工具的命令行实用程序。
L178: 
L179: cite86†English | 中文
L180: 
L181: ## 简介
L182: 
L183: SFTool是一个专为SiFli系列SoC（系统芯片）设计的开源工具，用于通过串行接口与芯片进行交互。它支持多种操作，包括向闪存写入数据、重置芯片等功能。
L184: 
L185: ## 特性
L186: 
L187:   * 支持SF32LB52、SF32LB55、SF32LB56、SF32LB57、SF32LB58芯片
L188:   * 支持多种存储类型：NOR闪存、NAND闪存和SD卡
L189:   * 可配置的串口参数
L190:   * 可靠的闪存写入功能，支持验证和压缩
L191:   * 灵活的重置选项
L192:   * 自定义连接尝试次数
L193: 
L194: ## 安装
L195: 
L196: ### 使用 Cargo 安装
L197: 
L198:     cargo install --git https://github.com/OpenSiFli/sftool
L199: ### 从源码编译
L200: 
L201:     # 克隆仓库
L202:     git clone https://github.com/OpenSiFli/sftool.git
L203:     cd sftool
L204: 
L205:     # 使用Cargo编译
L206:     cargo build --release
L207: 
L208:     # 编译后的二进制文件位于
L209:     # ./target/release/sftool
L210: ## Skills
L211: 
L212: 本仓库提供一个通用 `sftool` skill，可通过社区 `skills` CLI 安装到 Claude Code、Codex 和 GitHub Copilot。
L213: 
L214:     npx skills add OpenSiFli/sftool
L215: 
L216:     # 指定技能和目标 agent
L217:     npx skills add OpenSiFli/sftool --skill sftool -a claude-code
L218:     npx skills add OpenSiFli/sftool --skill sftool -a codex
L219:     npx skills add OpenSiFli/sftool --skill sftool -a github-copilot
L220: 
L221: 使用前请确保本机已经能直接调用 `sftool`，或者设置 `SFTOOL_BIN=/path/to/sftool`。该 skill 会先检查 `PATH` 和 `SFTOOL_BIN`；如果找不到命令，会立即停止并提示 LLM 环境配置有误。
L222: 该 skill 覆盖固件刷写、读回、`config` JSON 模板、区域擦除和常见排障，安装内容位于 `skills/sftool/`。
L223: ## 使用方法
L224: 
L225: ### 基本命令格式
L226: 
L227:     sftool [选项] 命令 [命令选项]
L228:     sftool [选项] config <FILE>
L229: ### 全局选项
L230:   * `-c, --chip <CHIP>`: 目标芯片类型 (目前支持SF32LB52、SF32LB55、SF32LB56、SF32LB57、SF32LB58)
L231:   * `-m, --memory <MEMORY>`: 存储类型 [nor, nor_type1, nand, nand_type1, nand_nobbm_type1, sd, sd_type1] (默认: nor，不区分大小写；`*_type1` 用于 SF32LB58 Type1 pinout)
L232:   * `-p, --port <PORT>`: 串行端口设备路径
L233:   * `-b, --baud <BAUD>`: 闪存/读取时使用的串口波特率 (默认: 1000000)
L234:   * `--before <OPERATION>`: 连接芯片前的操作 [default_reset, no_reset, no_reset_no_sync] (默认: default_reset)
L235:   * `--after <OPERATION>`: 工具完成后的操作 [soft_reset, no_reset] (默认: soft_reset)
L236:   * `--connect-attempts <ATTEMPTS>`: 连接尝试次数，负数或0表示无限次 (默认: 3)
L237:   * `--compat` : 兼容模式，如果经常出现超时错误或下载后校验失败，则应打开此选项。
L238: ### JSON 参数文件（sftool_param.json）
L239: 
L240: 可以用 JSON 描述一次命令并通过 `config` 子命令执行：
L241: 
L242:     sftool config sftool_param.json
L243: 
L244:     # CLI 参数可以覆盖或补充 JSON 中的字段
L245:     sftool -c SF32LB52 -p /dev/ttyUSB0 config sftool_param.json
L246: 
L247: JSON 文件可以不包含所有字段，CLI 参数与默认值会先合并；合并后仍缺少必须参数才会报错。 schema 位于仓库中的 `sftool_param_schema.json`。
L248: 
L249: ### 写入闪存命令
L250: 
L251:     # Linux/Mac
L252:     sftool -c SF32LB52 -p /dev/ttyUSB0 write_flash [选项] <文件@地址>...
L253:     # Windows
L254:     sftool -c SF32LB52 -p COM9 write_flash [选项] <文件@地址>...
L255: #### 写入闪存选项
L256: 
L257:   * `--verify`: 验证刚写入的闪存数据
L258:   * `-u, --no-compress`: 传输期间禁用数据压缩
L259:   * `-e, --erase-all`: 在编程前擦除所有闪存区域（不仅仅是写入区域）
L260:   * `<文件@地址>`: 二进制文件及其目标地址，如果文件格式包含地址信息，@地址部分是可选的
L261: ### 示例
L262: 
L263: Linux/Mac:
L264: 
L265:     # 写入单个文件到闪存
L266:     sftool -c SF32LB52 -p /dev/ttyUSB0 write_flash app.bin@0x12020000
L267: 
L268:     # 写入多个文件到不同地址
L269:     sftool -c SF32LB52 -p /dev/ttyUSB0 write_flash bootloader.bin@0x12010000 app.bin@0x12020000 ftab.bin@0x12000000
L270: 
L271:     # 写入并验证
L272:     sftool -c SF32LB52 -p /dev/ttyUSB0 write_flash --verify app.bin@0x12020000
L273: 
L274:     # 写入前擦除所有闪存
L275:     sftool -c SF32LB52 -p /dev/ttyUSB0 write_flash -e app.bin@0x12020000
L276: Windows:
L277: 
L278:     # 写入多个文件到不同地址
L279:     sftool -c SF32LB52 -p /dev/ttyUSB0 write_flash bootloader.bin@0x12010000 app.bin@0x12020000 ftab.bin@0x12000000
L280:     # 其它同上
L281: ## 库使用
L282: SFTool也提供了一个可重用的Rust库 `sftool-lib`，可以集成到其他Rust项目中：
L283: 
L284:     use sftool_lib::{SifliTool, SifliToolBase, WriteFlashParams};
L285: 
L286:     fn main() {
L287:         let mut tool = SifliTool::new(
L288:             SifliToolBase {
L289:                 port_name: "/dev/ttyUSB0".to_string(),
L290:                 chip: "sf32lb52".to_string(),
L291:                 memory_type: "nor".to_string(),
L292:                 quiet: false,
L293:             },
L294:             Some(WriteFlashParams {
L295:                 file_path: vec!["app.bin@0x10000".to_string()],
L296:                 verify: true,
L297:                 no_compress: false,
L298:                 erase_all: false,
L299:             }),
L300:         );
L301: 
L302:         if let Err(e) = tool.write_flash() {
L303:             eprintln!("Error: {:?}", e);
L304:         }
L305:     }

官方 README 的结论如下（只用其明确声明的范围）：

- 它称此通道为 **UART1 控制台**，没有出现 `DBG_UART1` 这个名称；映射为 **RX=PA18、TX=PA19**，经 CH340N，控制台速率为 **1 Mbps**。  
  [串口与节点](https://github.com/open-vela/vendor_sifli/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/boards/sf32lb52/lckfb_huangshan_pi/README_zh-cn.md#L60) · [引脚映射](https://github.com/open-vela/vendor_sifli/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/boards/sf32lb52/lckfb_huangshan_pi/README_zh-cn.md#L66)

- 板级 README 的标准烧录命令**显式**传入 `-b 1000000`，并指定复位流程和写入地址：

  ```bash
  sftool -c SF32LB52 -p /dev/ttyUSB0 -b 1000000 \
         --before default_reset --after soft_reset \
         write_flash cmake_out/lckfb_huangshan_pi/nuttx.bin@0x12010000
  ```

  [官方命令](https://github.com/open-vela/vendor_sifli/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/boards/sf32lb52/lckfb_huangshan_pi/README_zh-cn.md#L147-L150)

- 重要边界：**这个板级 README 仅证明推荐命令使用 1,000,000，不声称 `sftool` 的默认值是什么。**`sftool` 默认 1,000,000 应单独归因于当前本机 `sftool --help`（或工具官方 0.2.5 README 的 [`-b` 默认值](https://github.com/OpenSiFli/sftool/blob/0.2.5/README.md#L73)），不能归因给板级 README。

- 兼容模式的官方板级写法是裸标志 `--compat`，不是文档中的 `--compat true`：

  ```bash
  sftool -c SF32LB52 -p /dev/ttyUSB0 --compat \
         write_flash nuttx.bin@0x12010000
  ```

  [兼容模式示例](https://github.com/open-vela/vendor_sifli/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/boards/sf32lb52/lckfb_huangshan_pi/README_zh-cn.md#L153-L162)；工具官方 README 也以 [`--compat`](https://github.com/OpenSiFli/sftool/blob/0.2.5/README.md#L77) 记录。

- 镜像是平面 XIP，写入 **NOR `0x12010000`**；引导为 SoC ROM bootloader **SFBL**，无独立 bootloader/分区表。CH340N 的 RTS 直连低有效复位，自动烧录依赖此线路。  
  [镜像/引导架构](https://github.com/open-vela/vendor_sifli/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/boards/sf32lb52/lckfb_huangshan_pi/README_zh-cn.md#L99-L105) · [RTS 复位说明](https://github.com/open-vela/vendor_sifli/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/boards/sf32lb52/lckfb_huangshan_pi/README_zh-cn.md#L106-L110)

- 控制台应设为 **1,000,000 8N1、关闭流控**；推荐的安全打开方式为：

  ```bash
  picocom -b 1000000 --noreset --lower-rts --lower-dtr /dev/ttyUSB0
  ```

  RTS 复位后预期先看到 `SFBL`，再出现 NuttX/NSH。  
  [控制台命令](https://github.com/open-vela/vendor_sifli/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/boards/sf32lb52/lckfb_huangshan_pi/README_zh-cn.md#L167-L177) · [启动特征](https://github.com/open-vela/vendor_sifli/blob/dev-ai-contest-2026/boards/sf32lb52/lckfb_huangshan_pi/README_zh-cn.md#L179-L194)

补充工具源码事实：0.2.5 的 `write_flash` 将 `--verify` 默认设为 `true`，并注明传输中会读回数据；因此“后台传输并校验”与该版本行为一致。 [CLI 源码](https://github.com/OpenSiFli/sftool/blob/0.2.5/sftool/src/cli.rs#L125-L138)
